meta.title: Sunny Beach Amusement Park – Burgas, Bulgaria
meta.description: Complete travel guide to Sunny Beach Amusement Park in Burgas Province. Learn about this amusement park, including location, attractions, and visitor information.

intro.title: Discover Sunny Beach Amusement Park
intro.description: Sunny Beach Amusement Park (Лунапарк Слънчев бряг) is a popular amusement park located in Sunny Beach, Burgas Province, Bulgaria. It offers various rides and attractions for visitors of all ages.

visitGuide.title: Visit Tips
items: Best time to visit is during the evening when the park is lit up.
Purchase tickets online to avoid queues.
Check the weather forecast before your visit.
Bring cash for food and games.

sections.title: History & Development
sections.content: Sunny Beach Amusement Park has been a popular destination for tourists and locals alike. Over the years, it has expanded to include more rides and attractions.

sections.title: Attractions & Rides
sections.content: The park features various rides including roller coasters, carousels, and thrill rides. There are also arcade games and food stalls.

sections.title: Location & Access
sections.content: Located on Flower Street in Sunny Beach, the park is easily accessible by car or public transport. It's within walking distance from many hotels.

sections.title: Safety & Regulations
sections.content: The park follows strict safety regulations. All rides are regularly inspected to ensure visitor safety.

items.question: What are the opening hours of Sunny Beach Amusement Park?
items.answer: The park is typically open from 18:00 to 00:00 during peak season. Hours may vary depending on the season and weather conditions.

items.question: Is there an entrance fee?
items.answer: There is no entrance fee. Visitors pay per ride or can purchase a day pass for unlimited rides.

items.question: Are there food options available?
items.answer: Yes, there are several food stalls and snack bars offering a variety of options including local and international cuisine.

items.question: Is the park suitable for young children?
items.answer: Yes, the park has many rides suitable for young children, as well as family-friendly attractions.

transport.title: How to Get Here
transport.fromCenterDesc: About 35 km from Burgas city center. You can drive north along Route 9 (E87) for about 40 minutes, or take a bus to Sunny Beach from Burgas Bus Station South.
transport.fromStationDesc: Sunny Beach Central Bus Station is only about 800 meters from the amusement park. After getting off, walk towards the beach along Flower Street for about 10 minutes.
transport.fromAirportDesc: About 26 km from Burgas Airport (BOJ). The most convenient way is by taxi or pre-booked transfer (approx. 30 mins). You can also take Bus No. 10 directly from the airport to Sunny Beach.
transport.publicTransportDesc: Within Sunny Beach or from nearby Nessebar, you can take buses 1, 2, 5, or 8 and get off at the 'Center' or 'Flower Street' stops.
transport.walkingDesc: The park is located in the heart of Sunny Beach on Flower Street, the resort's main pedestrian area. If you are staying in Sunny Beach, it is an easy walk from most hotels.
transport.drivingDesc: Navigate to 'Sunny Beach Amusement Park'. Since it's in a central pedestrian zone, we recommend parking at one of the paid parking lots nearby (e.g., near the Central Bus Station) and walking to the park.
